Full description of a canvas node execution.
Should only be used for endpoints specific to executions.

More succint description of a canvas node execution.
No input, outputs, or root event.
Used to embed execution information into other messages.

versionId.description: Draft version to update when committing canvas.yaml or console.yaml.

autoLayout.description: When set, applies auto-layout while processing canvas.yaml updates.

version.description:
Version metadata only; workflow content is read via the repository files API
(use ?stage=true on the file GET to read effective staged content).

stagingSummary.description: Populated for draft versions to drive uncommitted/ready-to-publish indicators.

paths.description: Optional per-file revert. When empty, all staged files are discarded.

operations.description: canvas.yaml/console.yaml additions, updates, or deletions to stage verbatim.

CanvasesStagingSummary.description: StagingSummary reports the uncommitted spec edits held in workflow_staged_files for a draft version.

IntegrationCapabilityStateState.description:
- STATE_UNAVAILABLE: The integration has the capability available,
but the integration setup did not expose it,
and the user cannot request it anymore.
 - STATE_AVAILABLE: THe integration has the capability available,
but the integration setup did not expose it yet.
The user can still request it, though.
 - STATE_REQUESTED: The capability was requested,
but the setup flow did not yet exposed the capability requested.
 - STATE_ENABLED: The capability is fully available for use.
 - STATE_DISABLED: The capability was made available during the setup flow,
but has been manually disabled by the user.
